Accepted by Jack Heart on 2026-11-14 ("also that agents.md line is wrong I think"; chose option 1 of three): replace AGENTS.md's Layout paragraph with exactly — **Layout.** Lay the package out by the parts of the system: one folder per part the docs name, such as the controller, scheduler, provisioner and worker, called what the docs call it. Each part's import rule is enforced by a test. A grouping that is not a part of the system is not a folder. — This supersedes the note "a folder is added only when it has a rule a test can enforce" in the Task description; the provisioner gets its folder under this rule.
